experience.title: Studio Time: Start My Month Song
experience.markdown:
**Studio Time: Start My Month Song**

This month you will build one song, a little bit each studio day. Today: choose an instrument and place exactly four blocks to start your songs opening sequence. Keep it simple -- you will build on this same four-block start every studio day this month.

descriptor.title: Predict the Trace
descriptor.description: Two-item trace-prediction check: students read a shown 4-block sound program (play note / wait blocks) and predict what it will do before running it, picking from 3 choices. Kind, encouraging feedback either way, then a short takeaway tying back to tracing their own Month Song blocks.
